comment: Selects which application handles full page caching.
modal: Chooses the full page caching backend — the built-in Magento cache or an external caching application such as Varnish. The Varnish Configuration options apply when Varnish is selected.

comment: Downloads a Varnish 6 configuration (VCL) file based on the current cache settings.
modal: Generates and downloads a Varnish 6 VCL configuration file from the current cache settings. Shown in the Varnish Configuration group when Varnish is selected as the caching application.

comment: Downloads a Varnish 7 configuration (VCL) file based on the current cache settings.
modal: Generates and downloads a Varnish 7 VCL configuration file from the current cache settings. Shown in the Varnish Configuration group when Varnish is selected as the caching application.
